# @openid-federation/core (vendored)

Build of [openid-federation-ts](https://github.com/openwallet-foundation-labs/openid-federation-ts)
with the fixes of openwallet-foundation-labs/openid-federation-ts#27, #28 and #29 (OpenID Federation 1.0 only, no draft compatibility), which are not released yet.
EUDIPLO's backend uses it for OpenID Federation trust chain resolution.

Remove this folder and depend on the published `@openid-federation/core` release once it contains those fixes.
